title: Benny's, Bob Ford's, the Holiday Inn and Huck Finn's
summary: Smith and Goodwin help list the later rooms, working with Josh Johnson until his death, up to the closing of Huck Finn's.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Crook, did you have something to say?
I was trying to think where Baby and Josh went after 88 Keys.
Well, they went down to Bob Ford's
some time.
This was much later than that.
Well, before Ford's, you mean.
Yeah, they went someplace else before they went to Bob Ford's.
Benny's.
You went to Benny's on Prospect.
It's hard to think of those things. I remember you when you were --
She was right, she brought up a good one.
Yeah, Benny's down there on Prospect. A lot of swinging nights there. Then you went to Bob Ford's out on Truth.
That's right.
And you were there for quite a while.
That's right.
Now we're up into the mid- and late sixties.
Yeah.
And then I'm trying to think -- because you played so many rooms and it's hard for any of us to keep track of all of them. After Bob Ford's --
(Inaudible).
Then you and Josh, after Bob Ford's, continued to work together.
They continued -- you continued to work
with Josh up until he died.
Oh,yeah, oh, yeah.
They were always together, even when he -- until he died, yeah.
Yes.
And after Bob Ford's, I was just trying to think, I'm sure I caught you somewhere. Then I know you had that great gig down at the Holiday Inn with Fatts Dennis and [Elsie]L.C. Carr on piano.
Oh, yeah.
Or Lucky Wesley on base.
Right.
That was in the early seventies. They loved you there.
Oh, yeah.
And then from there you and I both wound up on the River Key. That brings us up to date. You were at Huck Finn's, Hot Pins, and we were around the corner at the Village Gate.
That's right up--
And you and I both -- well, you closed a little before my band closed, we're both closed now and we're both looking for work, and we're up to date. Isn't that right?
Right.
